# Reference implementation — do not edit

The four pages here (`bike-forward`, `bike-cashflows`, `bike-outsider`,
`bike-draw`) are the FROZEN source material Module 7 was built from. They
keep their original vocabulary and figures by design and are exempt from
course canon and course language rules — they are not student-facing.

The shipped module lives at the repo root (71-1 … 75-1, `graph-lab.js`,
`bike-graph-data.js`); its as-built record is
`Design-Docs/Module-7-Graph-Walk-Plan.md` and the ruling authority is
`Design-Docs/Module-7-Graph-Teach-Evaluation.md`. Fix things there, never
here.
